scholarships.title: CTU Scholarship for Foreign Students - Czech Technical University in Prague

existing.description: CTU awards a scholarship to foreign students who wish to take a Master study programme at the Czech Technical University in Prague and display qualities that entitle them to the award, and to foreign doctoral students capable of doing scientific work who study on a doctoral programme in English at CTU in Prague. The Master's award is a contribution towards the costs of a stay in the Czech Republic of up to CZK 10,000 per month for one to two semesters; the doctoral award covers the basic doctoral-study scholarship plus living costs of up to CZK 16,000 per month for six to twelve months. Both are financed equally from the rectorate's scholarship fund and the relevant faculty's fund, and are awarded under Act No. 111/1998 Sb. on Universities, section 91(3)(b). The award is a living-cost contribution and does not cover tuition fees.
eligibility: Master's track: a foreign student who wishes to take a Master study programme at CTU and displays qualities that entitle them to the award
Doctoral track: a foreign doctoral student capable of doing scientific work and studying on a doctoral programme in English language at CTU in Prague
Enrolled as a foreign student at the relevant faculty of CTU
Not eligible: Erasmus students at CTU
Not eligible: Erasmus Mundus students at CTU
Not eligible: Exchange students at CTU
Not eligible: CTU foreign students receiving a government scholarship
Master's track: must have the agreement of their faculty before applying
existing.eligibility_summary: Foreign students taking a Master study programme at CTU, or foreign doctoral students studying on an English-language doctoral programme at CTU in Prague, who are enrolled as foreign students at the relevant faculty and are not already holders of other scholarships or mobility grants.
benefits: Master's track: up to CZK 10,000 per month for 1-2 semesters
Doctoral track: up to CZK 16,000 per month for 6-12 months, covering the basic doctoral scholarship and living costs
Financed equally from the scholarship fund of the CTU rectorate and the scholarship fund of the relevant faculty or part of the university
Master's track: extension possible on excellent study results up to the standard length of the Master programme
Doctoral track: extension possible on excellent work outcomes up to the maximum standard length of the study programme
coverage: Master's track: contribution towards the costs of a stay in the Czech Republic up to CZK 10,000 per month
Doctoral track: the basic scholarship for doctoral study programmes plus living costs up to CZK 16,000 per month
requirements: Application routed through the faculty International Office to the Department of International Relations at the rectorate of CTU
Master's track: to qualify for an extension, all prescribed accredited courses for the first year of the Master programme must have been passed within the recommended time plan
Doctoral track: the individual study plan under Article 30 point 1 of the study and examination regulations is binding and forms part of the application
Doctoral track: one outcome of the study stay must be results published in an internationally reviewed journal, or an application submitted for an international grant
documents: b, Language Certificate The printed out forms are to be checked and confirmed/signed by the relevant coordinators at your home university. Upload the document into the registration database.
existing.english_requirement: Doctoral track: applicants must be studying on a doctoral programme in English language at CTU in Prague
application_method: Obtain the agreement of your faculty, then apply through the International Office at your faculty to the Department of International Relations at the rectorate of CTU
Use the application form published on the web pages of the CTU rectorate
existing.best_fit: The scholarship is intended for foreign students who wish to take a Master study programme at CTU and who display qualities that entitle them to the award of this scholarship.
existing.duration: 1-2 semesters initially, extendable to full Master's programme duration
existing.application_period: No intake calendar or deadline is published. The page describes a standing procedure: obtain the faculty's agreement, then apply through the faculty International Office to the Department of International Relations at the rectorate.
existing.deadline_display: No application deadline is published on the CTU Scholarships page. Applications are submitted to the Department of International Relations at the rectorate of CTU via the faculty International Office, with no published closing date or intake calendar.
existing.program_type: University scholarship for foreign students on Master's and doctoral study programmes under Act No. 111/1998 Sb. on Universities, section 91(3)(b)
